title: Topic Compaction Command Event v1
description: JSON envelope clients publish on the command queue to drive the MI's replay/delete flows.

command.description: Verb. Case-insensitive parsing happens at the boundary.

key.description: Required for REPLAY and DELETE. Ignored for BULK_REPLAY.

pattern.description: Required for BULK_REPLAY. Solace topic pattern with * (one level) or > (multi-level) wildcards.

options.description: Forward-compatible extension point. Unknown fields are tolerated.

correlationId.description: Echoed onto the replay/result message as x-original-correlation-id.

includeOriginalHeaders.description: If true, replays carry the original message's headers. Default true.

rateLimit.description: BULK_REPLAY only: maximum messages per second. Default 1000.

cascade.description: DELETE only: optional Solace pattern for bulk deletion (e.g. 'orders/created/test-*').
